steps.title: The browser
steps.text: Instruments, presets and samples live here. Drag an instrument onto the arrangement to make a track, or a sample to make an audio clip. The Search source finds anything in your library.

steps.title: The arrangement
steps.text: Each row is a track. Double-click in a track to add a clip, drag clips to move them and drag their edges to trim them.

steps.title: The note editor
steps.text: Double-click a MIDI clip and its notes open here. Draw with the pencil, paint a run with the brush, and use the Notes menu to quantise or transform.

steps.title: Play it
steps.text: Space starts and stops the song. The header shows the position, tempo and loudness.

steps.title: The Inspector
steps.text: Whatever you select - a track, a clip or a mixer channel - shows its settings here. Its More button lists everything you can do to it.
